{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check if flipper_length_mm has missing values
print("Missing flipper_length_mm:", penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())

# Compute mean flipper length within each island for each species
mean_flipper_by_species_island = penguins.groupby(['species', 'island'], as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Display the result
mean_flipper_by_species_island"}
